text:
Anna: Hey @eng-runtime — need a quick hand for a micro-launch claim: we want to say "~2x cheaper per-token vs cloud default" for a specific demo. Can eng/runtime produce a minimal, reproducible artifact bundle (raw traces + short runbook) we can link in the press pack? cc @Kai

Josh: Hey Anna — quick clarifying Qs: which exact model and quantization variant, which percentiles (p50/p95/p99), payload cohort size, and when do you need it? Also do you want coldstart numbers or warmed?

Anna: Model: Llama-3-70B (quantized q4f16 — the variant we used in the demo). Metric: p95 single-request latency (batch=1) and cost-per-token estimate. Payload: 200 synthetic prompts + 50 anonymized real prompts. Need a tiny artifact set by Fri EOD for the launch page (one raw traces zip + 1-paragraph runbook + CSV summary + 1 PNG heatmap).

Sam: We can do that. Do you have the exact prompt file and seed? If not we can sample from prod traces but must scrub PHI. Small runs should finish quickly.

Kai: I can assemble a stratified bundle (short/medium/long) + top-10 tail prompts. Will upload to internal s3 and share link.

bench-bot: Scheduled job queued: bench-sanity-run-1768887777. ETA ~4h. Reply `cancel` to abort.

Josh: Plan from runtime side: 1) you provide payload bundle (jsonl) 2) provide exact model config (hf name/commit, quant flags) + warmup tokens 3) provide expected ranges so we can flag regressions. We'll run 3 sweeps: coldstart, warmed (single warmup), and warmed-5 (repeat) and attach raw traces. What warmup did marketing use in the demo?

Anna: Warmup = the short warmup prompt used in the demo (20 tokens). Expected (from our internal dev runs): p95 ~420–480ms, cost ratio ~2.0–2.5x. But okay to surface if numbers differ.

Josh: Cool. Runtime will run on Hosted for speed; if we need determinism we'll reserve a small Dedicated slot. Example command we'll run (for reproducibility):

```
run_bench --model llama-3-70b --quant q4f16 --payload microlaunch-bundle.jsonl --warmup 20 --seed 42 --repeats 5 --out artifacts/1768887777
```

Sam: Assigning priority tag = `launch` so infra knows to prioritize. If hosted queue gets busy I'll spin a single dedicated GPU and re-run identically.

Kai: Upload done: https://internal-redwood/samples/microlaunch/1768887777-bundle.jsonl (s3 perms: marketing-readonly). Notes: seed=42, sampling=round-robin, split=200:50 short/real.

Anna: Perfect. Please add a 1-paragraph runbook we can link describing methodology, caveats (warmup, batch size, quantization), and how cost-per-token is computed.

bench-bot: Job finished: bench-sanity-run-1768887777. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/1768887777/artifacts.zip

Sam: Quick check of artifacts: no major regressions. p95=438ms, p50=210ms, cost ratio=2.12x vs cloud-default baseline. I uploaded runbook.txt and summary.csv into the artifacts bundle.

Anna: Amazing — can you also include a tiny percentile heatmap PNG (one slide) for marketing?

Josh: Yep — I'll export percentile heatmap (png) into the artifacts and add a 1-paragraph blurb for the press kit describing the methodology and limitations. Ping when it's in.

Kai: :thumbsup:

Anna: Thanks everyone — this is exactly what we needed.
